description: ENC-REKEY on an ACCDB with password 'pwk': CompactDatabase with SrcLocale ';pwd=pwk' and options 128+2 (encrypt), 128+4 (decrypt), 2 alone, 4 alone, 128 with DstLocale carrying ';pwd=' (empty) and 128 with ';pwd=pwn'. Each: marker error, the call, Errors, then the destination opened with no password, 'pwk' and 'pwn' (count) and the source unchanged. Asks which encrypt/decrypt option combinations ACE accepts on ACCDB and what the destination's password becomes.
